note: TR-71-117. Q-1 interview, FE-71-02 event 1. J-6 field cassette, 30 JUN 1971.
segments: How many people live in this house?
There are four chairs at the table.
It's a set. They come in fours.
There are four toothbrushes in the bathroom.
The fourth one has been used.
I would like you to leave now.

segments.speaker: CHILD
segments.text: Is he asking about the tall one?

segments: Go back to your room, honey.

segments.speaker: CHILD
segments.text: The tall one is flat now.
